# Striped Wall

> Independent product design and engineering studio for SaaS platforms, business systems and payment integrations.

Striped Wall brings product discovery, UX/UI design, software development and technical integrations together. The studio focuses on SaaS payments and the admin dashboards support and operations teams use to manage them.

Subdesk is a concept project with fictional data, illustrative HTML/CSS screens and an interactive browser demo. It does not process real payments or provide server authentication.

## Website

- [Studio](https://stripedwall.agency/): Services, process, selected work, studio background and contact details.
- [Subdesk case study](https://stripedwall.agency/work/subdesk/): Support and billing workspace concept, product screens, design approach and limitations.

## Optional

- [Subdesk demo](https://stripedwall.agency/subdesk-demo/): Interactive concept using browser storage and fictional transactions.
